title: vernonia sambiranensis
intro: Vernonia sambiranensis, commonly known as the Madagascar ironweed, is a plant species native to Madagascar, belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its traditional medicinal uses and has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Vernonia sambiranensis include wound healing, antipyretic, and analgesic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Additionally, the plant's bioactive constituents have been shown to exhibit anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory activities, highlighting its potential as a valuable resource for the development of new medicinal products.
